name: repo_memory_write
description: repo_memory (roadmap Phase 6, G5): persist this run's lessons onto the branch and decay stale ones (H10). Folds the run's learning board into the on-branch repo_memory file, re-runs decay, writes and commits it so later runs read it natively.

correlationId.description: Run id whose learning board lessons are folded in (if lessons not passed directly).
